title: Time Jump: 14:00, Level 2 in Effect and Shift Change

fields.narration: EXERCISE, EXERCISE, EXERCISE. A reminder before we go on: everything in this exercise is fictional. There is no method detail and no caller story, and anyone may step out at any time. Dr. Anneliese Park, our wellbeing contact, is in the room. It is now 14:00 on Thursday at the Great Plains Crisis Network in Lincoln. The Executive Director declared Level 2 at 13:50, and it is logged. For the last ten minutes both shift supervisors have been answering calls from the raised desks. The six trained administrative staff are finishing the surge refresher script with clinical coach Hannah Whitcomb and will log in to the text queue at 14:05. The ten routine follow-up callbacks are paused. The two imminent-risk follow-ups are still assigned. Down in the lobby, Calvin Whitehorse has 12 of the 14 evening counselors badging in at the security desk. The two driving from Grand Island are expected at about 14:10. Eight day-shift counselors are scheduled off at 14:30. Four people on the call-in list have confirmed so far and expect to arrive between 14:40 and 15:20. Nine have not answered, and three numbers from the workforce tool failed, but the tool still shows all 38 as available. The surge opening and closing scripts are shorter, but the risk assessment block stays in. Two deadlines are running. The Level 2 website and social post is due by 14:20. The text queue has been over its WATCH threshold since 13:20, so at 14:20 it will have been over threshold for 60 minutes. The wall board still shows texts at WATCH and calls at OK. Carry on from here.

fields.facilitatorNote: Pause after the narration and give the room 10–12 minutes. Look for four things: SC confirms the Level 2 actions in plan order; WFC chooses which of the 8 day-shift counselors to hold over within the 12-hour cap and counts only confirmed call-ins, not the tool's 38; COM drafts the Level 2 post and DCO checks it for safe messaging in time for 14:20; DCO confirms the 2 imminent-risk follow-ups stay assigned. Watch whether anyone sees that 14:20 is also the 60-minute backup-request target, but do not prompt it.
